officialSources.finding: Interior mobile-site deployment, current power-plus-ability passage threshold, Lift Tube exception, other vehicle restriction, and defense 3 when targeted as a character by a character weapon from either side.
Rearrangement preserves a legal location layout. Each Death Star Laser Gate has an optional relocation opportunity between interior Death Star sites. The continuation must offer a decline choice.

nativeScope: Free own-deploy-phase Gate deployment between adjacent interior mobile sites, including restricted-two admission and deployment cancellation.
Persistent exact-instance Gate and two-site references; source departure or site departure cannot revive an old binding.
Current power plus ability is checked on passage, in both directions; other vehicles are blocked. Lift Tube exception is expressed in the helper but full Lift Tube support is not claimed.
Gate game-text suppression disables passage restrictions and the Gate's weapon-target permission. Public view exposes both endpoints and active state.
Real ground movement resolves eligible Luke passage and rejects a weaker Rebel Trooper. Real location conversion rebinds the same physical gap to the new location card.

Retract removes the blanket Laser Gate exclusion for supported arrangements. Existing Gate pairs must remain adjacent; each Gate then receives a persisted optional relocation decision, with a decline choice.
Two Gate choices complete independently after serialization. Retract remains playing until every choice completes. Cancellation opens no relocation decision.
Validators reject missing Gate relocation entries, forged choice cursors, stale sources and incomplete physical bindings.

Resolve normal-battle weapon targeting timing separately; the card's as-if-character targeting permission alone does not establish battle participation or unrestricted firing timing.
Obtain independent conformance evidence if the reference implements these cards. Native tests and official-rule review are not GEMP parity.
